name: p-takeup-1100
description: Card P's take-up (the lead's ruling, 03:11): on the engine dyno, warm, held at 1100 rpm (the DD15's 'just over 1100'); started and the pedal at a fifth (light load) from 2 s, then to the floor at 6 s; read by report.py from the telemetry: the time from the pedal to 90 % of the build's own peak torque (its predicted curve's top).
